sv.title: Dödlig attack mot saudiskt oljeraffinaderi
sv.summary: Ett oljeraffinaderi i södra Saudiarabien har delvis stängt sedan anläggningen attackerats. En nepalesisk medborgare har dödats i angreppet.

en.title: Deadly attack on Saudi oil refinery
en.summary: An oil refinery in southern Saudi Arabia has partially shut down since the facility was attacked. A Nepali citizen has been killed in the attack.
